The oxygen lineup

One line for home, travel, and long-term therapy.

Match the device to the patient — ultra-portable, dual-flow, or stationary.

Ultra-portable POC

Zen-O lite™ Portable Concentrator

A lightweight pulse-mode portable oxygen concentrator built for reliability and active lifestyles.

  • Pulse mode up to 1,050 mL, adjustable in 0.5 steps to setting 5.
  • Just 5.5 lbs; approx. 5h45 battery at pulse setting 2.
  • Rate Responsive Therapy™, Eco Mode, and Auto Mode.
  • Easily replaceable sieve beds; 2-year warranty.

Dual-flow POC

Zen-O™ Transportable Concentrator

A best-in-class portable concentrator with both pulse and continuous flow for active patients.

  • Dual flow: pulse 1.0–6.0 and continuous up to 2 L/min.
  • Up to 9h40 runtime with two batteries at 18 BPM.
  • Holds up to two 8-cell batteries; ships with a pull cart.
  • Rate Responsive Therapy™; 3-year / 15,000-hour warranty.

Home / LTOT

M50 Stationary Concentrator

A lightweight, quiet stationary concentrator for Long-Term Oxygen Therapy in the home.

  • Continuous flow, adjustable up to 5 L/min.
  • A mere 33 lbs, quiet operation, compact and easy to move.
  • Integrated oxygen sensing with a low-purity alarm.
  • Fire-safe oxygen outlet; 3-year warranty.

Revolutionizing Portable Oxygen Therapy

Zen-O and Zen-O-Lite Review

Learn More about RRT Therapy and how the Ohio Medical line of GCE portable concentrators can enhance your patient compliance.

Rate Responsive Therapy™ keeps patients saturated — automatically.

Some portable concentrators deliver a fixed volume of oxygen per minute, so the bolus shrinks and FiO₂ drops as a patient breathes faster — forcing the patient to turn the setting up. GCE's Rate Responsive Therapy delivers a constant bolus and automatically responds to the patient's breath rate, so oxygen delivery actually increases with activity instead of decreasing.

  • Delivers a constant bolus regardless of breath rate.
  • Automatically increases oxygen as the patient's demand rises.
  • Keeps patients saturated even at high breath rates.
  • No need to change device settings before activity.
  • Up to 44% more oxygen than some devices at 25 BPM.

Why dealers choose Ohio Medical POCs

Efficient. Effective. Clinically sound.

Rate Responsive Therapy™

A constant bolus that adapts to breath rate keeps patients saturated during activity — a clear clinical talking point.

Dual-flow flexibility

Zen-O offers both pulse and continuous delivery, so one device covers a wider range of patients.

Lightweight portability

At 5.5 lbs, the Zen-O lite is ideal for patients who want independence outside the home.

Field-replaceable sieve beds

Sieve beds can be replaced by most home oxygen providers without returning the device to the factory.

Clarity connected care

Clarity-enabled POCs give providers device usage history, notifications, and remote data points.

3-year warranty

A 3-year (or 15,000-hour) device warranty backs the portable lineup.
